info.name: Cassini
info.summary: Record, transcribe, and publish Nextcloud Talk meetings.
info.description:
Cassini records a Nextcloud Talk call without joining as a participant, then transcribes and publishes a readable archive in Nextcloud Files. Optionally, it can also summarize each meeting when you configure an OpenRouter (or compatible) API key. Recording control and job history live in the admin-only control panel; each private recording is readable only by the people who had access to the Talk room (its attendee list) when it was published, enforced by Nextcloud's own advanced file ACLs.
Data processing: recording and speech-to-text transcription run entirely within your own infrastructure. No audio or transcript leaves your servers for those steps. Optional LLM meeting summaries are the only step that sends data to a third party, and they run only when an LLM endpoint is configured. Without one, nothing leaves your infrastructure. See the full data-processing note: https://github.com/codemyriad/gocassini/blob/main/docs/privacy.md
info.author: codemyriad

variable.name: CASSINI_TALK_RECORDING_SECRET
variable.description: Shared secret for Nextcloud Talk's recording backend protocol. Must match the "secret" in Talk's recording_servers setting (occ config:app:set spreed recording_servers). Required for the Talk "Start recording" button: without it the operator rejects every recording request.

variable.name: CASSINI_TALK_SIGNALING_INTERNAL_SECRET
variable.description: Shared internal secret for standalone Nextcloud Talk signaling / HPB. Must match the signaling server's [clients] internalsecret. Required for HPB-internal recording (the invisible recorder used for private, group, and one-to-one calls) — it cannot be auto-generated. How to find it: on Nextcloud All-in-One run `docker exec nextcloud-aio-talk printenv INTERNAL_SECRET`; on a standalone HPB it is the [clients] internalsecret in the signaling server config. See docs/exapp-install.md.

variable.name: CASSINI_TALK_BACKEND_URL
variable.description: Base URL the operator uses to call back into Nextcloud Talk (recording started/stopped notifications and recording upload). Leave empty to use the backend URL Talk sends with each recording request, which is correct for almost every deployment.

variable.name: CASSINI_NC_ADMIN_USER
variable.description: The Nextcloud account Cassini acts as when it creates its recordings folder, groups and service account. Leave empty to detect an administrator automatically; set it only if detection picks the wrong account. This is used for one-time setup, never for storing or reading recordings — those use the dedicated "cassini" service account.

variable.name: CASSINI_PUBLISH_SINK
variable.description: Selects the publish destination: "nextcloud-files" stores recordings in Nextcloud Files under Cassini/Recordings (the default for an installed app, and the only mode with per-participant access control), or "local" keeps them on the app's own volume. Leave empty unless you specifically need the local mode; an installed app defaults to nextcloud-files so recordings are never silently kept off Nextcloud. The nextcloud-files mode needs the Group folders ("Team folders") and Everyone Group (group_everyone) apps enabled first — Cassini provisions the folder and ACL topology itself but cannot install a PHP app. See docs/exapp-nextcloud-recordings-permissions.md.

variable.name: CASSINI_ARTIFACT_RETENTION
variable.description: How much of each recording's per-run working files Cassini keeps on its own volume. "sealed" (the default) reclaims a completed run's working copies, all of which are duplicated in the canonical library or were temporary staging, and keeps the sealed meeting file and every log. "superseded" only reclaims runs a rerun has replaced. "all" keeps everything, which is the escape hatch when something needs to be recovered from a completed run. Nothing removes the last copy of anything, and published recordings are never touched. Leave empty unless you are diagnosing a problem.

variable.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
variable.description: Initial API key for the LLM summary endpoint (see LLM_BASE_URL), used to pre-fill the app's LLM settings on first start; afterwards manage keys in the app. Leave empty when the endpoint needs no key, as a self-hosted model server usually does not.

variable.name: LLM_BASE_URL
variable.description: Initial OpenAI-compatible API base URL for meeting summaries — a hosted provider or your own model server. It pre-fills the app's LLM settings on first start; afterwards endpoints are managed in the app without a redeploy. Leave empty to start with no LLM endpoint. Defaults to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 when OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set.

variable.name: LLM_MODEL
variable.description: Initial model identifier for meeting summaries (default: openai/gpt-4o-mini); pre-fills the app's LLM settings on first start.

variable.name: CASSINI_ROOM_ID_PEPPER
variable.description: Deployment-wide secret mixed into the one-way derivation of each meeting's room id, so the Talk conversation token it is derived from cannot be recovered by enumeration. Recommended. Choose it ONCE: changing it changes every room id, and meetings already published keep the ids they were written with, so rooms split. Re-running scripts/backfill-catalog-rooms.sh --apply repairs every meeting this installation has a job row for; only recordings imported from elsewhere need the manual merge in scripts/reattribute-catalog-room.sh.

variable.name: CASSINI_OPERATOR_API_TOKEN
variable.description: When set, direct (non-proxied) requests to the operator job API must send "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Requests proxied through Nextcloud are authenticated by AppAPI and are unaffected. Leave empty to keep the API reachable only through the AppAPI proxy authentication.

variable.name: CASSINI_STT_BACKEND
variable.description: Which registered speech-to-text engine transcription uses. Leave empty for the default (sherpa-onnx). An unknown value fails the build loudly before any audio is decoded, so a typo cannot silently select a different engine.

variable.name: CASSINI_DISALLOW_MODEL_DOWNLOAD
variable.description: Set to 1 on a host with no outbound network access. Each image bundles the model of the quality tier it runs by default, and any other tier is downloaded once into the model cache on the persistent volume. With this set, the operator blocks a build whose tier needs a download and says which tier to select instead, rather than starting a build that cannot reach the network.

variable.name: CASSINI_ATTRIBUTION_DISABLED
variable.description: Set to 1 to skip the cross-track speaker-attribution stage entirely. By default every word is annotated with acoustic evidence of who was speaking; no words are changed or removed either way.

variable.name: CASSINI_ATTRIBUTION_DROP
variable.description: Set to 1 to delete words the acoustic evidence contradicts instead of annotating them. Intended for room systems where one microphone audibly picks up every participant. The manifest records how many words were removed.
